parameters.name: ct
parameters.description: Overall coupling strength of V1 to top quarks, Eq.(1)

parameters.name: theta
parameters.description: Chirality angle, tan(theta) = cR/cL. Set to Pi/2 for right-handed coupling as in paper benchmark, Eq.(1)

lagrangian_terms.name: L_V1_kin_mass
lagrangian_terms.expression: -1/4 FS[V1, mu, nu] FS[V1, mu, nu] + 1/2 MV1^2 V1[mu] V1[mu]

lagrangian_terms.name: L_V1_int
lagrangian_terms.expression: ct * uqbar[sp, 3, cc].Ga[mu].(Cos[theta] * ProjM[sp, sp2] + Sin[theta] * ProjP[sp, sp2]).uq[sp2, 3, cc] * V1[mu]

raw_preamble: MV1 == { ParameterType -> External, Value -> 1500., BlockName -> TOPPHILIC, OrderBlock -> 1, InteractionOrder -> {NP, 0}, Description -> "Mass of the top-philic vector resonance V1 [GeV], Eq.(1)" };
